description_short.value: Ghanaian investment company holding listed and unlisted equities and investment property, listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since April 2014.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Mega African Capital Limited 2025 Annual Report (GSE PR 386/2026: nature of business; statement of financial position) and the GSE listed-companies page (date listed 23/04/2014)

description_full.value: Mega African Capital Limited is a Ghanaian investment company. It is authorised to develop, buy, sell and let real estate and to invest in equities, fixed income and other financial services; most of its assets are equity investments and investment property. It listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange on 23 April 2014 after a restricted share offer. It added shares through a rights issue and private placement in 2015 and a debt-to-equity conversion in favour of Databank EPACK Investment Fund in 2016, bringing its issued shares to about 9.95 million. It paid final dividends of GHS 0.05 a share for 2014 and GHS 0.06 for 2015, but none for 2021 to 2025. Its dividend and rental income is small (GHS 2.0 million in 2025), and it made a net loss every year from 2021 to 2025 (GHS 29.0 million in 2025), mainly from finance costs, which include exchange losses. Gains in the value of its investments, recorded in other comprehensive income, more than offset those losses from 2021 to 2024 but not in 2025. Its balance sheet also carries tenured client deposits of GHS 173.2 million at the end of 2025, of which GHS 141.8 million is accrued interest, against shareholders' funds of GHS 87.5 million. Its Managing Director, Kwesi Amonoo-Neizer, holds 533,939 shares. Its office is at Kanda Estates, Accra.
